experiments.question: Does generic discover-then-read guidance reduce complete-run usage?
experiments.comparison: Neutral vs scoped guidance; three fresh source-investigation pairs, six native sessions, alternating order
experiments.gate: All six exact fact/source checks pass; >=5% pooled native-token reduction; >=2 pair wins
experiments.result: All quality checks pass, but 269570 -> 301326 total native tokens (+11.78%); 1/3 wins. No adoption.

experiments.question: What retained output coverage do existing lossless transforms actually have?
experiments.comparison: Retrospective source-preserving audit; unique outputs separated from event presentations
experiments.gate: Report coverage, retained-byte effect and gaps; never infer token/task savings
experiments.result: 6/413 unique outputs transformed; 1925451 -> 1742273 retained bytes. No model calls.

experiments.question: Can one call for genuinely independent reads avoid extra model round trips?
experiments.comparison: Three fresh investigations, sequential vs batched independent reads, same source/model/facts, reversed order across cases
experiments.gate: Freeze protocol before inference; all exact checks pass, >=5% complete-run token reduction and >=2/3 pair wins; preserve each command exit status; no batching of dependent reads
experiments.rollback: Keep native defaults unless fresh confirmation supports adoption

experiments.question: Do maintained command filters preserve errors, warnings and edge cases while reducing whole-task usage?
experiments.comparison: Offline raw-vs-filtered fixture checks first: successful, failing and unfamiliar test/search/git outputs; then at most three paired repair tasks
experiments.gate: Resolve all advisory findings and artifact/provenance/script review before execution. No automatic rewrite hooks. Retain raw output/exit codes. Every independent repair check passes and >=10% whole-task model-token reduction
experiments.rollback: Remove explicit wrapper; native commands remain default

experiments.question: Does a token-budgeted symbol map reduce broad repository exploration?
experiments.comparison: Map off vs fixed-budget map on three fresh multi-file navigation/repair tasks; full file reads available in both arms
experiments.gate: Review/pin complete dependency graph; count map generation/cache refresh and all inference; same independent quality checks; source edits invalidate map; >=10% complete-task token reduction
experiments.rollback: Remove supplied map; retain normal file/search tools

experiments.question: Can focused checks reduce finite test runtime without missing regressions?
experiments.comparison: Full suite vs affected-test-first with mandatory full final check; three fresh dependency-free repair tasks
experiments.gate: Independent final full suite in both arms; failures and cross-file regressions retained; measure total runtime and inference, not focused-test runtime alone
experiments.rollback: Use full verification immediately when dependency mapping is uncertain

experiments.question: Does learned compression help irregular documentation output beyond reversible folds?
experiments.comparison: Offline guards for numeric values, negation, exceptions, citations and truncation; only then raw vs compressed documentation investigations
experiments.gate: Pin/review model weights and runtime graph. Never compress source edits/system/user constraints. Include compressor runtime, model use and retrieval overhead; all quality checks pass and >=10% total inference-cost scenario reduction
experiments.rollback: Raw output remains available; no default deployment from offline ratios

experiments.question: Can native datasets/scores display matched trials without a second evaluation system?
experiments.comparison: Use synthetic nonprivate experiment metadata to verify dataset item, run, trace and score identity against existing immutable local results
experiments.gate: No evaluator model calls, no duplicate token observations, idempotent receipts and no private log exposure; inspect installed API compatibility first

experiments.question: Does a frozen selected improvement transfer to real coding tasks?
experiments.comparison: Separately preregister fresh varied repositories/tasks and independent checks; exclude tasks used to choose/tune the candidate
experiments.gate: No tuning or stopping on held-out outcomes; include all calls/retries/integration and research overhead; do not claim broad quality from source fact retrieval
experiments.note: Cap and sample size must be set in a separate protocol; zero here means not launched
